name: Loader
summary: React loading indicator with 17 variants — spinner, dots, bars, ASCII and more — installable via shadcn or copy-paste.
description: A React and Next.js loading indicator component with seventeen variants: spinner, dots, bars, dot-matrix, dither, morph, comet, scramble, metaballs, newton, helix, percent and five terminal-style ASCII spinners. Everything scales from one size prop, uses currentColor, and swaps every transform for an opacity pulse under reduced motion.
contains: 17 loading variants, incl. ASCII, dither, morph, metaballs, newton and helix loaders
props: variant, size, speed, label, className
install with the shadcn CLI or copy-paste the TSX source
reduced-motion fallback swaps every transform for an opacity pulse
free; the site also sells beUI Pro (292+ blocks and premium motion components)
